34892019.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic optical neuroimaging (fNIRS/diffuse optical tomography); no AI/ML classifier, only PSF simulation metrics

34899510.clinical_problem: Classifying whether a student has received formal mathematics education from brain MRI of the intraparietal sulcus region
34899510.patient_population: 123 adolescent students (72 with math education, 51 without)
34899510.model_description: Multi-instance contrastive learning extracts representations from cropped MRI images of the intraparietal sulcus region, then a linear neural network classifies whether a student belongs to the math-trained or non-math group.
34899510.headline_result: 90.24% classification accuracy, >5% improvement over classical contrastive learning baseline

34925537.clinical_problem: Assessing CT imaging changes before and after interventional (bleomycin sclerotherapy) treatment of pediatric lymphangioma
34925537.model_description: A convolutional neural network segments lymphangioma tumor regions on CT images before and after interventional treatment to quantify tumor size/feature changes and assess treatment response.
34925537.headline_result: CNN segmentation Dice similarity coefficient 0.9; interventional therapy effective in 96.67% of cases
34925537.study_design: retrospective single-center study (NOTE: publication_types includes 'Retracted Publication')

35253021.clinical_problem: Characterizing coupled structural and microstructural brain development trajectories in youth from longitudinal multi-modal MRI
35253021.patient_population: 679 youths from the National Consortium on Alcohol and Neurodevelopment in Adolescence (NCANDA)
35253021.model_description: Autoencoders reduce longitudinal T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted MRI to latent representations; a self-supervised method (Longitudinal Correlation Analysis) finds maximally correlated directions of change between the two modalities to characterize coupled brain development.
35253021.dataset_size: 679 youths, longitudinal T1 and diffusion MRI
35253021.study_design: retrospective longitudinal multimodal neuroimaging methods study (MICCAI)

35528703.clinical_problem: Accurately segmenting brain tissue types on pediatric brain MRI affected by motion/Gibbs artifacts across multiple imaging sites
35528703.patient_population: multi-site pediatric brain MRI (iSeg2019 challenge data)
35528703.model_description: A multi-scale self-supervised learning framework trains coarse and fine tissue-segmentation models on downsampled and original brain MR images, then applies iterative site-specific self-supervised training to segment brain tissue despite artifacts and site differences.
35528703.study_design: retrospective algorithm development / benchmark study (MLMI workshop)

32008282.clinical_problem: Differentiating types of pediatric posterior fossa brain tumors (medulloblastoma, ependymoma, pilocytic astrocytoma) using routine MRI
32008282.patient_population: 99 children with pathology-confirmed posterior fossa tumors (medulloblastoma n=59, ependymoma n=13, pilocytic astrocytoma n=27)
32008282.model_description: Wavelet-transformation texture features extracted from ADC MRI images of the whole tumor are fed into a random forest classifier to distinguish three types of pediatric posterior fossa brain tumors.
32008282.headline_result: Random forest classifier accuracy 86.8% (validation); sensitivity 100%/94.8%/76.9%, specificity 97.6%/88.0%/98.8% across tumor pairs

32483398.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; conventional image signal-intensity normalization software, not a machine-learning model

32856729.clinical_problem: Automated generation of standard diagnostic imaging planes for fetal echocardiography from 3D/4D ultrasound volumes
32856729.model_description: Sonography-based Volume Computer-Aided Diagnosis (SonoVCAD) software processes 3D/4D ultrasound volume datasets acquired from the fetal 4-chamber view to automatically generate 8 standard fetal echocardiography diagnostic planes.
32856729.release_evidence: SonoVCAD (Sonography-based Volume Computer Aided Diagnosis) is a named commercial software product
32856729.headline_result: Success rate per diagnostic plane 90.6-99.6%; inter-observer kappa 0.439-0.933; intra-observer kappa 0.602-0.903
32856729.study_design: prospective reader-reliability study of automated volume computer-aided diagnosis software

34422223.clinical_problem: Accurately segmenting brain tissue (white/gray matter) on 6-month-old isointense-phase infant brain MRI, which is difficult due to low tissue contrast
34422223.model_description: A 3D cycle-consistent generative adversarial network (3D-cycleGAN-Seg) synthesizes higher-contrast 24-month-old-style images from 6-month infant MRI scans, using segmentation-consistency and feature-matching losses to jointly train a segmentation model for isointense infant brain tissue.

32181449.model_family: deep neural network / label distribution learning
32181449.clinical_problem: Predicting infant chronological age from brain MRI to study brain development, addressing insufficient training data at each age
32181449.patient_population: 384 brain MRI scans from infants 35 to 848 days after birth
32181449.model_description: A deep neural network combined with granular label-distribution learning uses cortical morphometric features from structural infant brain MRI to predict age in days, augmenting information from limited per-age samples.

30449721.exclusion_reason: general adult-focused chest CT technique review; pediatric imaging mentioned only in passing; no specific AI/ML model described

28818093.exclusion_reason: non-imaging AI (artificial neural network applied to DNA microarray gene-expression data), not image analysis

28823587.clinical_problem: Distinguishing gastrointestinal, depressive, and eating-disorder symptom etiology in a single adolescent patient using functional MRI response to experimental pain
28823587.patient_population: 1 adolescent patient with mixed eating-disorder, depressive, and GI symptoms
28823587.model_description: Supervised machine learning classifies a single patient's functional brain imaging response to an experimental pain paradigm, together with self-report psychological data, to identify which diagnostic phenotype (GI, depressive or eating-disorder) the patient's pattern most closely resembles.
28823587.study_design: single-patient case report using supervised machine learning classification

29202135.clinical_problem: Accurate tissue segmentation of isointense-phase (~6-month) infant brain MRI, challenging due to low tissue contrast from ongoing myelination
29202135.model_description: Local AdapTivE and Sequential Training (LATEST) trains local random-forest classifiers per voxel using neighboring atlas training samples, iteratively refining tissue-probability maps to segment isointense infant brain MRI.

31741701.clinical_problem: Detecting brain functional-connectivity changes associated with different levels of sub-concussive head-impact exposure in youth football players using resting-state MRI
31741701.patient_population: youth football players (non-contact, low-impact and high-impact exposure groups)
31741701.model_description: Group independent component analysis extracts resting-state brain networks from fMRI, and supervised machine learning classifiers predict whether a youth football player had no, low, or high cumulative head-impact exposure based on network connectivity patterns.
31741701.study_design: prospective cohort study with machine-learning classification (IEEE ISBI)

27356798.clinical_problem: Differentiating common pediatric cerebellar tumor types (ependymoma, medulloblastoma, astrocytoma) using MRI texture analysis
27356798.patient_population: 76 children with posterior cranial fossa tumors
27356798.model_description: Gray-level co-occurrence matrix texture features extracted from MRI are classified using a support vector machine (SVM) to differentiate three types of pediatric posterior fossa tumors.
27356798.headline_result: SVM accuracy: ependymoma vs medulloblastoma 86.15%, ependymoma vs astrocytoma 73.63%, medulloblastoma vs astrocytoma 74.32%

27413248.clinical_problem: Parcellating the fetal cortical surface into anatomically meaningful regions despite the lack of consistent anatomical landmarks across gestation
27413248.patient_population: cohort of healthy and high-risk fetuses
27413248.model_description: A Random Forest learns geometrical mesh-signature features to parcellate the fetal cortical surface, refined with an alpha-expansion graph-cut using the forest's probability maps, producing an unsupervised brain parcellation from fetal MRI surface data.

27446888.clinical_problem: Reviewing multivariate pattern-recognition analysis techniques applied to fetal, neonatal and pediatric brain MRI for brain cancer and neurological injury
27446888.patient_population: fetal, neonatal and pediatric populations imaged with brain MRI (systematic review, not a single cohort)
27446888.model_description: Systematic review synthesizing multivariate analysis (pattern-recognition) methods applied to MRI of the developing brain for identifying biomarkers, understanding injury/cancer etiology, and supporting diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

25837791.clinical_problem: Determining whether an individual was born preterm versus at term from structural brain MRI in adolescence, as a potential biomarker of altered development
25837791.patient_population: 143 individuals (69 controls, mean age 14.6y); preterm defined as birth weight <=1500g and gestational age <37w
25837791.model_description: A linear support vector machine (SVM) trained on grey-matter-segmented T1-weighted MRI classifies individuals as born preterm versus at term.
25837791.headline_result: 93% correct classification (leave-one-out); 86% and 91% accuracy on split-half validation

25082551.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; case report/evolutionary theory paper on quadrupedal locomotion, adult siblings

25365804.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; conventional voxel-based morphometry and multiple-regression analysis only

23548217.clinical_problem: Improving accuracy of prenatal ultrasound-based estimated fetal weight (EFW), particularly reducing operator-dependent measurement error
23548217.patient_population: 2127 singleton pregnancies for ANN development; 100 new-operator cases for evaluation
23548217.model_description: An artificial neural network (ANN) estimates fetal weight from ultrasonographic parameters; Akaike information criterion (AIC) selects compensation weightings for operator-dependent measurement variability, and a minimum mean squared error (MMSE) step determines the final estimate.
23548217.headline_result: Mean absolute percent error 5.1% +/- 3.1%, mean absolute error 158.9 +/- 96.2 g; outperformed conventional EFW formulas (p<0.05)
23548217.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and evaluation study

23276557.clinical_problem: Improving accuracy of ultrasound-based fetal weight estimation by first classifying fetal size subgroups
23276557.model_description: K-means clustering classifies fetuses into size groups based on a selected ultrasonographic parameter, then group-specific artificial neural network (ANN) models estimate fetal weight.
23276557.headline_result: Mean absolute percent error 5.26% +/- 4.14%, mean absolute error 157.91 +/- 119.90 g; outperformed conventional EFW formulas (p<0.05)

23366186.clinical_problem: Segmenting airway shapes on chest X-ray to support detection of lymphadenopathy associated with pediatric tuberculosis
23366186.model_description: Active shape models, built from manually segmented training images and warped via affine transformation to user-defined control points, segment airway boundaries on chest X-rays as a step toward automated classification of TB-related lymphadenopathy.

21786166.clinical_problem: Building an accurate neonatal brain MRI template for spatial normalization, to support development of a template-based computer-aided diagnosis system for neonatal cerebral disorders
21786166.model_description: Three template-construction approaches (individual neonatal head, skull-stripped individual head, and an average of 7 neonatal MRIs) are compared for spatially normalizing neonatal brain MRI, intended as infrastructure for a future computer-aided diagnosis system.
21786166.headline_result: Population-average template had significantly higher normalization accuracy than the conventional adult template and other approaches (P<0.01)

19735097.model_family: RBF network / backpropagation network / SVM ensemble
19735097.clinical_problem: Automatically recognizing and locating fetal genital organs on prenatal ultrasound images
19735097.model_description: A two-stage algorithm first selects candidate points of interest on ultrasound images, then a multi-classifier framework combining radial basis function network, backpropagation network and support vector machine classifies and locates fetal genital organs.
19735097.headline_result: True positive 80.5%, true negative 83.0%; average computation time 453 ms/image

40930590.clinical_problem: Explaining what radiomics is and its potential clinical applications, for a pediatric clinician audience
40930590.model_description: Educational overview of radiomics (quantitative feature extraction from medical images) written for pediatric clinicians; abstract text not available.
40930590.study_design: educational review (Archives of Disease in Childhood Education and Practice edition)

41379899.clinical_problem: Reducing radiation dose in pediatric CT by denoising low-dose CT images to normal-dose quality without requiring paired structurally-aligned training data
41379899.patient_population: simulated low-dose CT datasets across three dose levels plus real low-dose CT images
41379899.model_description: An enhanced diffusion posterior sampling (E-DPS) framework combines a one-step U-Net denoiser (trained on simulated low-dose/normal-dose CT pairs) with an unconditional diffusion model prior, taking a noisy low-dose CT image as input and producing a denoised, normal-dose-quality CT image.
41379899.headline_result: PSNR gains of +5.2% and +4.3% at unseen dose levels vs state-of-the-art methods; strong zero-shot generalizability on real low-dose CT
41379899.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study using simulated and real low-dose CT data

41388953.clinical_problem: Reducing radiation dose and contrast medium while maintaining image quality in cardiac CT angiography for infants with congenital heart disease
41388953.patient_population: infants with congenital heart disease undergoing cardiac CTA
41388953.model_description: Deep-learning reconstruction (DLR) applied to 256-detector CT at 70 kVp reconstructs cardiac CT angiography images from lower radiation dose and contrast medium, compared against 64-detector CT with adaptive statistical iterative reconstruction at 80 kVp.
41388953.headline_result: 41% radiation dose reduction and 49% contrast-medium reduction with no significant difference in vascular enhancement or contrast-to-noise ratio (P>.05)

41452608.clinical_problem: Predicting which children with cochlear implants will have high versus low spoken-language improvement, from pre-implant brain MRI
41452608.patient_population: 278 children with cochlear implants (bilateral sensorineural hearing loss), 3 centers (US, Australia, Hong Kong)
41452608.model_description: Traditional machine learning and deep transfer learning (bilinear attention-based fusion) models take neuroanatomical features from presurgical 3D volumetric brain MRI as input and output a binary prediction of high versus low post-cochlear-implant spoken-language improvement.
41452608.headline_result: Deep transfer learning accuracy 92.39%, sensitivity 91.22%, specificity 93.56%, AUC 0.98

41484902.exclusion_reason: broad review of AI in neurodevelopmental disorders (clinical data, robotic platforms, interpretability); not primarily about radiologic imaging

41493547.exclusion_reason: adult cirrhosis/HCC LI-RADS surveillance study (Child-Pugh class, elderly patients); not pediatric

41494544.clinical_problem: Identifying neural signatures of increased pain-empathy reactivity in adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury using fMRI and machine learning
41494544.patient_population: 29 adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury, 33 healthy controls
41494544.model_description: Machine learning analysis of whole-brain fMRI activation patterns during pain-empathy tasks discriminates adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury from healthy controls, alongside univariate statistical comparisons.
41494544.headline_result: Machine-learning whole-brain pattern showed superior discrimination for physical-pain empathy in NSSI (no single aggregate accuracy/AUC reported)

41508047.exclusion_reason: narrative review of AI in obstetric anesthesia; not focused on radiologic imaging

41510574.clinical_problem: Predicting spontaneous preterm birth from first-trimester cervical length measured by AI-assisted ultrasound
41510574.patient_population: 1664 archived transvaginal ultrasound images from pregnant women in first trimester (Hong Kong)
41510574.model_description: A ResUNet-based deep learning model (combining U-Net and ResNet) automatically measures cervical length on transvaginal ultrasound images ('AI-line' method), compared against conventional single-line and two-line manual measurement for predicting preterm-birth risk.
41510574.headline_result: AUROC 0.676 for predicting spontaneous preterm birth <37 weeks; 0.777 for <32 weeks (AI-line method)
41510574.study_design: retrospective secondary analysis of prospectively collected ultrasound images

41526020.clinical_problem: Establishing a large pediatric chest X-ray repository to evaluate and optimize computer-aided detection (CAD) algorithms for childhood tuberculosis, since adult-trained CAD underperforms in children
41526020.patient_population: children and young adolescents (0-15 years) with presumptive TB; up to ~11,000 CXRs from ~20 studies
41526020.model_description: Protocol for the CAPTURE repository: existing and new pediatric chest X-rays with consensus radiological classification will be used to evaluate current adult-trained computer-aided detection (CAD) products for TB and to fine-tune/optimize new pediatric-specific CAD algorithms.
41526020.dataset_size: up to ~11,000 chest X-rays from ~20 studies
41526020.study_design: protocol for a global multicenter study

41526555.clinical_problem: Detecting subtle cardiac abnormalities on echocardiography in children with post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC), not apparent on standard echo parameters
41526555.model_description: A ResNet-50-based deep learning model analyzes echocardiographic images to distinguish children with PASC from controls based on subtle cardiac imaging differences not captured by standard echo parameters.

41531344.clinical_problem: Reviewing how AI can improve diagnostic accuracy and prognostic evaluation for pediatric bacterial pneumonia, which is difficult to distinguish clinically from other respiratory conditions
41531344.model_description: Narrative review of AI-driven diagnostic tools that process chest imaging and heterogeneous patient data to detect pediatric bacterial pneumonia and flag early signs of severe disease; no single model described.

41535441.clinical_problem: Predicting which pediatric patients with Chiari I malformation and autism spectrum disorder will show ASD symptom improvement after posterior cranial fossa decompression surgery, using morphometric imaging parameters
41535441.patient_population: pediatric patients with symptomatic Chiari I malformation and ASD who underwent posterior fossa decompression
41535441.model_description: A binary tree classifier AI model uses morphometric parameters measured on CT and MRI (e.g., tentorium angle, cerebellar tonsil descent) to identify pediatric Chiari I/ASD patients likely to improve after posterior cranial fossa decompression surgery.
41535441.headline_result: Tentorium angle cut-off of 89.55 degrees distinguished outcome groups

41537944.clinical_problem: Radiation-free estimation of Cobb angle for pediatric/adolescent scoliosis screening, replacing radiographic measurement
41537944.model_description: A convolutional neural network extracts asymmetry features from a 3D back-surface reconstruction (via fringe projection profilometry) to predict the Cobb angle, a radiographic scoliosis severity index, without using X-rays.
41537944.headline_result: Correlation coefficient 0.94 with radiographic Cobb angle (R^2=0.88); prediction time ~3.3 s

41544306.clinical_problem: Characterizing white-matter microstructural abnormalities and lateralization in children with autism spectrum disorder using diffusion MRI tractography, and testing whether these metrics distinguish ASD from typically developing children
41544306.patient_population: 36 children with ASD (mean age 5.44y), 27 healthy controls (mean age 5.06y)
41544306.model_description: Automated fiber quantification tractography extracts white-matter diffusion metrics along 12 tracts from diffusion tensor MRI; a support vector machine classifier uses these metrics to distinguish children with autism spectrum disorder from healthy controls.

41545817.clinical_problem: Accurately measuring adenoid volume and quantifying nasopharyngeal airway obstruction in three dimensions for pediatric adenoid hypertrophy / obstructive sleep apnea
41545817.patient_population: three CBCT datasets: 63 pediatric OSA patients (pre/post adenoidectomy), 26 more post-adenoidectomy patients, 161 patients with polysomnography+CBCT
41545817.model_description: A SegResNet-based deep learning model, trained on preoperative cone-beam CT to predict postoperative airway morphology after adenoidectomy, segments the adenoid (via the volumetric difference) and computes a novel Three-Dimensional Adenoidal-Nasopharyngeal Ratio (3D-AN) index of airway obstruction.
41545817.dataset_size: 126 CBCT scans (63 patients) + 26 patients + 161 patients across three datasets
41545817.headline_result: Segmentation Dice similarity coefficient 0.88; relative volume error 0.09; 3D-AN ratio >0.18 correlated with OSA (r=0.56, P<0.01)

41547810.exclusion_reason: dental board exam LLM benchmarking (ChatGPT/Gemini on dentistry specialization exam); non-imaging, not pediatric radiology

41556979.clinical_problem: Identifying brain functional-connectivity networks predictive of problematic video-gaming severity in youth, using task-based and resting-state fMRI
41556979.patient_population: 1,036 participants from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, mean age 12.0 years
41556979.model_description: Connectome-based predictive modelling (CPM), a machine-learning approach using whole-brain functional connectivity from task-based and resting-state fMRI, predicts problematic-gaming severity scores in youth.
41556979.headline_result: CPM predicted problematic-gaming scores r=0.12, p=0.002
41556979.study_design: cross-sectional cohort study with machine-learning predictive modeling

41567817.clinical_problem: Reviewing methods to reduce radiation dose in pediatric CT head imaging while maintaining diagnostic image quality, including AI-based deep-learning image reconstruction
41567817.model_description: Scoping review of 24 articles on radiation-dose reduction techniques for pediatric CT head imaging, concluding that deep-learning image reconstruction (DLIR) algorithms enhance image quality at ultra-low radiation doses compared with conventional reduction techniques.

41575808.clinical_problem: Quantifying fetal brain maturation via ultrasound-based gestational-age estimation in early-onset fetal growth restriction, to assess whether delayed maturation predicts neonatal complications
41575808.model_description: A deep-learning model trained on optimally developing fetuses estimates gestational age from the size/shape of brain fissures and structures (Sylvian fissure, parieto-occipital fissure, calcarine sulcus, cerebellum) on 3D ultrasound; the difference from true gestational age serves as a maturation-delay marker in growth-restricted fetuses.
41575808.headline_result: Estimated GA significantly lower than actual GA (deltaGA -3.2 to -5.4 days across measures, P<0.0001); greater delay associated with perinatal complications

41589908.clinical_problem: Reviewing 4D ultrasound, structured scoring systems and AI platforms for prenatal assessment of fetal neurobehaviour to identify neurodevelopmental vulnerability
41589908.model_description: Narrative review of 4D-ultrasound-based fetal neurobehavioural assessment tools (KANET, prenatal General Movements Assessment) and AI-assisted classifiers providing objective quantification of fetal movement and facial activity from ultrasound video.

41593252.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI technologies (deep learning, machine learning, decision support, biosignal analysis) for diagnosing pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders, including neuroimaging-based diagnosis
41593252.model_description: Scoping review of 22 studies: deep-learning models applied to neuroimaging achieved diagnostic accuracies exceeding 85% for pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders, while supervised machine learning improved autism/ADHD subtype classification.
41593252.headline_result: Deep-learning models exceeded 85% diagnostic accuracy in neuroimaging interpretation in most included studies

41595680.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI/ML applications, most robust in imaging, for diagnosis, risk stratification and treatment-response assessment in pediatric endocrine tumors
41595680.model_description: Pediatric-focused narrative review of AI/ML in endocrine tumors, covering imaging-based approaches such as CT/PET radiomics for metastatic risk and treatment response (largely extrapolated from adult evidence) alongside survival-prediction and recurrence models.

41604478.exclusion_reason: ophthalmic strabismus diagnosis via wearable skin strain sensors ('Eyelectronics'); non-radiologic imaging modality

41605965.clinical_problem: Providing a large annotated dataset and baseline classifier for detecting and classifying pediatric forearm (ulna and radius) fractures on X-ray
41605965.model_description: The PediURF dataset provides over 10,000 radiologist-annotated pediatric ulna/radius radiographs labeled by fracture type (proximal, midshaft, distal); URFNet, a dual-view (anteroposterior + lateral) classification model, is proposed and benchmarked on the dataset for automated fracture-type classification.
41605965.release_evidence: publicly available collection of >10,000 de-identified images (Scientific Data descriptor)
41605965.headline_result: URFNet achieved the best classification performance compared with other classification models (specific metric not given in abstract)
41605965.study_design: dataset descriptor with benchmark model development

41614047.clinical_problem: Characterizing individual functional brain architecture ('fingerprints') during childhood and adolescence using deep learning on longitudinal fMRI
41614047.patient_population: longitudinal neuroimaging cohort, childhood through early adolescence
41614047.model_description: Metric-BolT, a deep metric learning framework, extracts individual 'brain fingerprints' from longitudinal functional MRI to identify subjects across scan sessions and characterize developmental trajectories.

41615635.clinical_problem: Predicting Cobb angle from smartphone-based 3D surface topography to screen and monitor adolescent idiopathic scoliosis without radiation
41615635.patient_population: 125 patients (105 analyzed after exclusions) plus external data (142 controls, 188 scoliosis patients)
41615635.model_description: An AI-powered smartphone application analyzes 3D surface-topography scans (standing and forward-bending) to predict radiographic Cobb angle for scoliosis screening and monitoring.
41615635.dataset_size: 125 patients (79 training, 26 validation) + 142 external controls, 188 external scoliosis patients
41615635.headline_result: Correlation with radiographs r=0.922; MAE 5.9 deg overall, 6.4 deg in AIS 10-50 deg; AUC 0.978 at 10 deg, 0.917 at 25 deg, 1.000 at 40 deg
41615635.study_design: single-institution observational validation study with external data augmentation

41619014.clinical_problem: Evaluating whether an adult-trained, FDA-cleared AI tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection performs adequately on non-contrast head CT in children aged 6-17
41619014.patient_population: 1,996 non-contrast head CTs, children/adolescents 6-17 years, 21 sites
41619014.model_description: An FDA-cleared, adult-trained AI tool analyzes DICOM head CT images to flag intracranial hemorrhage; performance is compared against radiologist-adjudicated ground truth derived with an NLP tool applied to reports.
41619014.release_evidence: FDA-cleared, adult-trained AI tool for ICH detection

41620570.clinical_problem: Predicting Cobb angle without radiation using 3D surface topography for adolescent scoliosis monitoring
41620570.model_description: Principal component analysis reduces dimensionality of 3D surface-topography data; several machine-learning models (linear regression, neural networks, XGBoost, stacking) were compared, with a linear regression model (LRM) selected as best for predicting Cobb angle.
41620570.headline_result: MAE 3.97 deg, RMSE 4.70 deg, correlation r=0.91 (linear regression model)
41620570.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and internal validation study

41626705.exclusion_reason: prediction model uses tabular clinical/hematologic markers and discrete documented ultrasound findings as inputs, not image-analysis AI

41637843.clinical_problem: Comparing image quality between low-dose deep-learning-reconstructed and standard-dose iteratively-reconstructed pediatric abdominal CT
41637843.model_description: Deep-learning reconstruction (DLR) applied to thin-slice (0.5mm) low-dose pediatric abdominal CT images is compared against standard-dose thick-slice (3.0mm) hybrid iterative reconstruction (HIR), evaluating noise, contrast-to-noise ratio, edge sharpness, and diagnostic confidence.
41637843.headline_result: 59.5% lower radiation dose with DLR; equivalent contrast-to-noise ratio and higher diagnostic-confidence score (4.5 vs 3.4, p<0.001)

41640707.clinical_problem: Predicting event-free survival and stratifying risk in children with hepatoblastoma before surgery, to guide neoadjuvant chemotherapy decisions
41640707.patient_population: 106 patients (74 training, 32 external testing), two hospitals
41640707.model_description: Deep-learning-based radiomics features automatically extracted from segmented pre-treatment MRI (T1 and T2) are combined into a deep-learning-based radiomics (DLBR) score, integrated with clinical variables into a nomogram to predict event-free survival in pediatric hepatoblastoma.
41640707.headline_result: Integrated clinical-DL nomogram outperformed clinicopathologic predictors and the DLBR score alone for survival prediction (specific AUC not given)
41640707.study_design: retrospective two-center study with external validation

41646770.body_region: whole fetal body, placenta, amniotic fluid
41646770.clinical_problem: Automating volumetric measurement of the fetus, placenta and amniotic fluid on 3D reconstructed T2-weighted MRI to enable normative growth curves for clinical use
41646770.patient_population: 357 healthy control pregnancies (16-41 weeks GA) plus 95 longitudinal scans (42 fetuses) and 86 preterm pregnancies
41646770.model_description: A 3D U-Net, applied after deformable slice-to-volume 3D reconstruction of motion-corrupted T2-weighted MRI stacks, automatically segments the fetus, placenta and amniotic fluid; a reporting tool then generates centiles and z-scores for normative volumetric growth.
41646770.dataset_size: 357 healthy controls; 95 longitudinal scans (42 fetuses); 86 preterm pregnancies
41646770.headline_result: Automated 3D segmentation required only minor corrections (<1% volume difference) in <25% of control datasets; preterm pregnancies had significantly lower fetal, placental and amniotic-fluid volumes/centiles than term controls
41646770.study_design: retrospective methodology-development study with normative modeling (medRxiv preprint)

41651962.clinical_problem: Inferring neurocognitive test scores in adolescents/young adults with congenital heart disease from brain imaging combined with genetic, clinical and socioeconomic factors
41651962.patient_population: 89 adolescents and young adults with CHD (mean age 16 years)
41651962.model_description: A multivariate model combining structural and diffusion brain MRI features with biological, socioeconomic, clinical and genetic data, built via forward-inclusion/backward-elimination with cross-validation, infers scores across 15 neurocognitive tests in seven domains.
41651962.headline_result: Correlation r=0.245-0.648 across domains; mean MAE 6.3 points; best for Digit Span (r=0.65)
41651962.study_design: retrospective cohort study with cross-validated multivariate modeling

41670428.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI applications (chest X-ray CAD and prediction models) for diagnosing and managing pediatric tuberculosis in resource-constrained settings
41670428.model_description: Literature review of AI-driven chest X-ray analysis (CNNs, transfer learning, stacked ensemble ML) for detecting pediatric tuberculosis, alongside prediction models for treatment outcomes.
41670428.headline_result: Sensitivity 76.0-98.2%, specificity 70.0-98.0%, AUC up to 0.98 across reviewed AI-CXR TB detection studies

41682830.clinical_problem: Evaluating whether a vision-language foundation model can detect contrast-agent presence and esophageal strictures on pediatric esophageal radiographs
41682830.model_description: BiomedCLIP, a vision-language foundation model, is applied zero-shot (no fine-tuning) to classify pediatric esophageal radiographs for contrast-agent presence, esophageal visibility, and stricture presence.
41682830.headline_result: Contrast detection: precision 88.7%, AUC 85.4%; stricture detection: accuracy 24%, sensitivity 44%, AUC 0.26 (poor)

41685379.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI-based methods for pediatric bone-age assessment from hand/wrist radiographs and the challenges limiting generalizability
41685379.model_description: Educational review of AI approaches (including an RCNN-based model evaluated by mean absolute error) for automated bone-age assessment from hand and wrist radiographs, discussing dataset diversity and validation limitations.

41697038.model_family: large language model + traditional ML (SVM, KNN, random forest, ANN)
41697038.clinical_problem: Predicting need for shunt-revision surgery in pediatric ED patients with suspected shunt malfunction, using clinical, historical and radiographic (shunt series) variables
41697038.patient_population: 1,167 pediatric ED neurosurgical consults for suspected shunt malfunction (2017-2022)
41697038.model_description: Multiple machine-learning models (SVM, K-nearest neighbors, random forest, artificial neural network) and a proprietary large language model (ShuntGPT) take 24 historical, clinical and radiographic variables (including shunt series findings) as input to classify whether a child needs shunt-revision surgery.
41697038.headline_result: Best models: ANN accuracy 84%/AUC 0.88; ShuntGPT accuracy 87%/AUC 0.927; without imaging, ShuntGPT AUC dropped to 0.84

41701019.clinical_problem: Evaluating how test-set composition (difficulty) affects measured performance of AI fracture-detection models for pediatric appendicular radiographs
41701019.model_description: EfficientNet (classification) and YOLOv8 (object detection) models trained to detect pediatric appendicular fractures on radiographs are evaluated on a 'difficult' test set (discordant initial/final reads) versus a 'matched' test set to quantify the effect of test-set composition on measured AI performance.
41701019.dataset_size: 39,703 patients; difficult set 392 patients/786 radiographs, matched set 526 patients/786 radiographs
41701019.headline_result: Difficult test set: 40% lower odds of correct classification for EfficientNet (OR 0.60) and 80% lower odds of detection for YOLOv8 (OR 0.20) vs matched set
41701019.study_design: retrospective diagnostic accuracy study comparing test-set compositions

41717043.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation and quantification of pediatric abdominal visceral and subcutaneous fat on free-breathing 3D MRI, to assess metabolic disease risk, despite limited pediatric training data
41717043.patient_population: 134 children (6-18 years) and 920 adults (5 adult centers)
41717043.model_description: A cross-cohort federated learning framework trains a 3D neural network to segment visceral and subcutaneous adipose tissue on free-breathing 3D Dixon MRI, jointly leveraging a pediatric cohort and a separate multi-site adult cohort without sharing raw data.
41717043.headline_result: Dice 91.09% (VAT), 95.55% (SAT); ICC 0.99 (VAT), 1.00 (SAT) volume agreement; inference <3 s/subject
41717043.study_design: prospective multi-site federated-learning method development study

41718532.clinical_problem: Segmenting hepatoblastoma tumors on pediatric CT and MRI, since models trained on adults generalize poorly to children
41718532.patient_population: 104 participants (CT dataset, mean age 28.2 months), 123 participants (MRI dataset, mean age 31.5 months); Children's Oncology Group AHEP0731 trial
41718532.model_description: Two 3D U-Net deep-learning models, trained specifically on pediatric contrast-enhanced CT and T2-weighted MRI respectively, segment hepatoblastoma tumors and are compared against an adult-trained model and manual annotations.
41718532.dataset_size: 104 pediatric CT cases, 123 pediatric MRI cases (multicenter COG trial)
41718532.headline_result: Pediatric-trained CT model Dice 0.86 (vs 0.55 for adult-trained model); pediatric-trained MRI model Dice 0.86

41724217.exclusion_reason: general commentary on demographic bias in neuroimaging AI across all ages and major datasets (HCP, ADNI, UK Biobank, ABCD, OpenNeuro); not pediatric-specific

41728295.clinical_problem: Automating comprehensive quantitative and qualitative echocardiographic measurements in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients, where expert interpreters are scarce
41728295.patient_population: 60,269 patients / 217,435 echo studies (internal, Boston Children's Hospital); 2,506 patients / 3,096 studies (external)
41728295.model_description: EchoFocus-Measure, a multi-task view-agnostic deep-learning architecture (extending PanEcho with a study-level transformer), automatically extracts 18 quantitative parameters (e.g., LVEF) and 10 qualitative assessments from full pediatric/congenital heart disease echocardiogram studies.
41728295.dataset_size: 217,435 internal echo studies (60,269 patients); 3,096 external studies (2,506 patients)
41728295.headline_result: LVEF median absolute error 2.8% internal, 3.8% external; qualitative-measure AUROC 0.88-0.95 internal, 0.73-0.86 external
41728295.study_design: retrospective multicenter development and external validation study (medRxiv preprint)

41729215.clinical_problem: Reviewing current models (including AI/ML) for predicting spontaneous preterm birth in the second trimester
41729215.model_description: Review of current second-trimester preterm-birth prediction models and their limitations; abstract text not available.

41730874.clinical_problem: Quantifying normative growth trajectories of fetal brain structures from ultrasound to define a fetal brain maturation index and detect deviations associated with neurodevelopmental outcome at 2 years
41730874.patient_population: 4,205 fetal brain scans, 18-27 weeks gestation, multi-national healthy cohort
41730874.model_description: Deep-learning methods automatically measure 16 fetal brain structures from 3D ultrasound to derive 28 region-specific normative growth trajectories and a fetal brain maturation index quantifying biological versus chronological age; the method is publicly available and runs in under 10 seconds per scan.
41730874.dataset_size: 4,205 fetal brain ultrasound scans, multi-national cohort
41730874.headline_result: Between-site differences explained only 0.6-5.8% of total variance across growth trajectories

41730897.exclusion_reason: broad scoping review of AI in respiratory primary care/pulmonology across all ages; imaging is a minor component among many non-imaging AI applications

41731261.exclusion_reason: animal (mouse) model study of sickle cell arteriopathy, not human pediatric patients

41740307.exclusion_reason: systematic review of conventional neuroimaging findings in adolescent borderline personality disorder; AI/ML mentioned only as a future research direction, not applied in included studies

41749633.exclusion_reason: dental imaging application (panoramic-radiograph-based molar extraction indications); excluded as dental per scope rules

41751232.exclusion_reason: general fMRI methodology narrative review (presurgical mapping); not pediatric-specific

41758854.clinical_problem: Real-time diagnosis of fetal congenital heart disease from ultrasound in resource-constrained settings lacking specialized clinicians
41758854.model_description: Liquid-Sequencer, a lightweight deep-learning model combining depthwise-separable/squeeze-excitation convolutional feature extraction with a bidirectional Liquid Neural Network sequence module, classifies fetal congenital heart disease from cardiac ultrasound for real-time 'digital twin' diagnostic support.
41758854.headline_result: Strong performance with only 0.30M parameters across 12 datasets (specific accuracy not given in abstract)

41762048.clinical_problem: Improving classification of autism spectrum disorder in a community-based adolescent cohort by integrating multimodal brain MRI with physical-health markers (sleep, growth, development)
41762048.patient_population: ABCD study participants with and without ASD, propensity-score matched
41762048.model_description: Multimodal machine-learning models integrate structural, diffusion, and resting-state functional MRI with physical-health markers (sleep, growth, early development) to classify autism spectrum disorder status in a population-based adolescent cohort.
41762048.headline_result: AUC-ROC 0.68 (95% CI 0.62-0.73), AUC-PR 0.66 for multimodal model
41762048.study_design: cross-sectional cohort study with propensity-matched machine-learning classification

41772028.clinical_problem: Automated detection and classification of key fetal anatomical structures on first-trimester ultrasound to support early fetal anomaly screening
41772028.patient_population: 4,532 first-trimester fetal ultrasound scans (11-14 weeks), 9 medical centers
41772028.model_description: YOLOv11 and Swin Transformer object-detection models localize nine fetal brain/craniofacial structures on ultrasound; radiomic and deep features from the detected regions are fused and classified by a TabTransformer model into clinically defined anatomical categories.
41772028.headline_result: External test classification accuracy 96.1%, AUC up to 96.89%, sensitivity >95%; detection IoU up to 0.97, F1>=0.94
41772028.study_design: retrospective multicenter algorithm development and external validation study

41797514.clinical_problem: Using a machine-learning brain-age model to identify structural deviations in children with dystonia and predict outcomes after deep brain stimulation surgery
41797514.patient_population: 37 children with dystonia vs matched healthy controls; brain-age model trained on 2,623 normative scans
41797514.model_description: A machine-learning brain-age model, trained on thousands of normative developmental T1-weighted MRI scans, computes a 'brain-age gap' (predicted minus chronological age) from pre-surgical MRI in children with dystonia, tested as a biomarker of motor severity and deep-brain-stimulation outcome.
41797514.dataset_size: 37 children with dystonia; normative training set n=2,623
41797514.headline_result: Greater brain-age gap in dystonia vs controls (P<0.001); associated with worse baseline motor scores and poorer 1-year quality-of-life improvement

41808587.clinical_problem: Automating identification and image-quality auditing of the fetal left ventricular outflow tract view in routine obstetric ultrasound screening
41808587.patient_population: 180 screening report files (1,097 images), low-risk pregnancies
41808587.model_description: A deep-learning pipeline identifies left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) views in obstetric ultrasound screening images and scores 7 predefined image-quality criteria to produce an interpretable 0-7 summary quality score.
41808587.headline_result: Sensitivity 97.7%, specificity 90.0% for LVOT presence; ICC 0.902 for summary score
41808587.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

41822143.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML classifier; group functional-connectivity modeling (CS-GIMME) and statistical comparison only

41845286.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (tooth identification/numbering on panoramic radiographs); excluded as dental per scope rules

41846244.exclusion_reason: broad review of AI/IoT/point-of-care devices in maternity care; not focused on radiologic imaging

41858109.clinical_problem: Reliably quantifying perivascular spaces in the basal ganglia on infant brain MRI to study the glymphatic system, which is challenging in infants
41858109.model_description: A deep-learning method using anatomy-informed pseudo-labels jointly segments the basal ganglia (BG) and BG perivascular spaces (PVS) on infant brain MRI across three cohorts with different acquisition protocols.
41858109.headline_result: BG Dice 0.91 (dHCP), 0.86-0.89 (external with fine-tuning); PVS quantification agreement r=0.90-0.99, ICC>=0.96
41858109.study_design: retrospective multi-cohort technical development and validation study

41862126.clinical_problem: Using a large language model to recommend surgical fusion levels (upper/lower instrumented vertebrae) for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis surgery, based on structured clinical and radiological (Lenke classification) data
41862126.model_description: DeepSeek-R1, a large language model, receives structured clinical and radiological data (including Lenke classification derived from spinal imaging) as text prompts and outputs recommended upper and lower instrumented vertebrae levels for scoliosis fusion surgery.
41862126.release_evidence: DeepSeek Reasoning Model R1 (DeepSeek-R1) is a publicly available large language model
41862126.headline_result: Surgically reasonable fusion levels (Likert >=3) in 70.9% of cases (144/203); ICC 0.840 inter-rater agreement

41865530.clinical_problem: Improving deep-learning-based automatic biometry from intrapartum ultrasound video to monitor labor progress where trained sonographers are scarce
41865530.patient_population: 774 videos (68,106 images), 3 hospitals (IUGC Grand Challenge dataset)
41865530.model_description: The Intrapartum Ultrasound Grand Challenge (IUGC, with MICCAI 2024) framework integrates standard-plane classification, fetal head-pubic-symphysis segmentation, and biometry measurement; this paper reviews eight teams' submitted deep-learning methods and analyzes their preprocessing, augmentation, architecture and post-processing choices.
41865530.release_evidence: "The solutions and the complete dataset are publicly accessible"

41868248.exclusion_reason: ophthalmic imaging (fundus photography and optical coherence tomography); excluded as non-radiologic imaging

41875228.clinical_problem: Reviewing MRI-based synthetic CT (deep learning) as a radiation-free alternative to conventional CT for orthopaedic bone imaging, with particular relevance in children
41875228.model_description: Perspective/review of deep-learning-based synthetic CT generation from MRI sequences (zero echo time, ultrashort echo time, 3D gradient recalled echo) as a radiation-free bone-imaging alternative to CT, with particular relevance to pediatric patients.

41880065.clinical_problem: Automating tumor segmentation and PET parameter extraction for pediatric glioma [18F]F-DOPA PET scans, replacing time-consuming manual delineation
41880065.model_description: A U-Net deep-learning model, fine-tuned via transfer learning from adult glioma datasets, automatically segments pediatric brain tumors on [18F]F-DOPA PET scans and extracts static and dynamic PET parameters (e.g., tumor-to-striatum ratio).
41880065.dataset_size: 103 pediatric patients (90 for statistical/survival analysis, 32 for dynamic analysis)
41880065.headline_result: Dice score 0.82 +/- 0.11; automated indices correlated significantly with tumor grade and survival (p<0.05)

41880682.clinical_problem: Comparing image quality and radiation dose between deep-learning and hybrid iterative reconstruction in unenhanced pediatric chest CT
41880682.model_description: Deep-learning image reconstruction (DLIR) is compared against hybrid iterative reconstruction (HIR) for unenhanced pediatric chest CT, assessing subjective and objective (noise, attenuation) image quality and radiation dose across age groups.
41880682.headline_result: Lower image noise with DLIR (e.g., lung 63 vs 81 HU, p=0.017); radiation dose reduced (CTDIvol 1.6 vs 4.3 mGy; effective dose 0.70 vs 2.51 mSv, p<0.001)

41890183.clinical_problem: Improving automated bone-age assessment accuracy by modeling segment-specific skeletal maturation instead of assuming uniform maturation across the hand, in Indian children
41890183.model_description: digiBONE segments hand radiographs into short-bone, carpal and wrist regions and trains separate convolutional neural networks for each segment plus a full-hand model; segmental predictions are combined into a composite Greulich-Pyle bone-age estimate.

41892775.exclusion_reason: orthodontic cephalometric-analysis reliability study (dental specialty imaging); excluded as dental per scope rules; cohort also includes adults

41899834.clinical_problem: Automating extraction of the four-chamber view and cardiac biometric parameters from fetal cardiac ultrasound to screen for congenital heart disease
41899834.model_description: YOLOv7 detects the four-chamber view (4CV) in fetal cardiac ultrasound videos; UNet 3+ and SegFormer segment cardiac structures to automatically compute cardiothoracic area ratio, cardiac axis, and cardiac position for congenital heart disease screening.
41899834.headline_result: AI models achieved screening performance comparable to expert obstetricians (22 obstetricians in comparison study)
41899834.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study with clinical comparison

41912959.clinical_problem: Automated 3D classification of pediatric hydrocephalus from ventricular enlargement on head CT, improving on conventional 2D CT indices
41912959.patient_population: 98 pediatric head CT examinations (0-15 years; 48 hydrocephalus, 50 normal)
41912959.model_description: A multiscale attention 3D convolutional neural network (MSA3DNet) classifies pediatric head CT scans as hydrocephalus versus normal based on 3D ventricular enlargement, benchmarked against a conventional 3D CNN.

41939780.clinical_problem: Early prediction of refractory Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children using clinical, imaging and radiomics features from chest CT
41939780.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from chest CT (via PyRadiomics) are combined with clinical and imaging variables in random-forest models to predict which children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia will develop a refractory (treatment-resistant) course.
41939780.headline_result: Integrated model AUC 0.811 (95% CI 0.704-0.917) in external validation, vs radiomics-only 0.784 and clinical-imaging-only 0.675
41939780.study_design: retrospective multicenter study with external validation

41961108.clinical_problem: Assessing the diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted ultrasound interpretation for infant developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), which is normally highly operator-dependent
41961108.patient_population: 29 studies; 9 studies (6,351 hips) pooled in meta-analysis
41961108.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI applied to 2D/3D infant hip ultrasound for detecting developmental dysplasia of the hip, compared against expert Graf-based interpretation or clinical follow-up as reference standard.
41961108.study_design: systematic review and diagnostic test-accuracy meta-analysis

41975681.clinical_problem: Reviewing radiomics-based machine learning for differentiating benign from malignant orbital masses and surgical planning, and examining barriers to generalizability and equity, including lack of pediatric representation in datasets
41975681.model_description: Narrative review of radiomics-based machine-learning models for orbital-disease diagnosis, margin assessment, and surgical planning across ophthalmology, otolaryngology and plastic surgery, highlighting dataset bias including underrepresentation of pediatric patients.

41977162.exclusion_reason: general cardio-oncology review of cardiotoxicity management; AI mentioned only in passing as a future direction, not focused on pediatric radiology imaging

41981480.exclusion_reason: machine learning on serum biomarkers (ferritin, transferrin) to predict an ultrasound-derived measurement (carotid intima-media thickness); not image-analysis AI; predominantly adult population with pediatric subgroup
